package.name: amr_core
package.description: Single source of truth for the fleet: a model library describing each robot TYPE (geometry, dynamics, safety, priority) and a fleet file instantiating named robots from those models with their spawn poses. Every other package reads this instead of carrying its own copy, which is what previously let spawn poses drift between four separate launch files and let per-robot YAML silently fail to load when a node name and a YAML root key disagreed.
